reviewed_music_events.role: first lift: widen the world or reveal the team's scale
commitment: move from setup into unmistakable threat or action
re-entry: escalate after the musical valley with a stronger visual idea
climax: place the strongest collision, confrontation, or destructive image

story_brief: Recut one visual world into a concise action trailer: establish the human team and their weapon, reveal the mechanical threat and scale of the battle, escalate after the musical valley, peak on the strongest robot confrontation or collision, then resolve during a short audible decay. Every selected shot must advance that same conflict. The four reviewed musical events are editorial targets, not interchangeable metronome ticks: assign each one the visual role stated in reviewed_music_events. There is no second source quota and no parallel-world conceit.
